title: Thirdway heading
description: A big medium-weight grotesk heading, 40px on phones to 72px on desktop, tracked tight (-0.06em). Each line rises about 60px and fades in, one after the other, as the heading scrolls into view.
notes: needs a tight neo-grotesk display font at weight 500
scroll-driven CSS: browsers without it show the heading in place
name: thirdway-heading

props.name: text
props.description: the heading; "\n" starts a new line, and each line rises into place in turn
